statement: AMD disclosed agreements with OpenAI and Meta to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD data center GPUs each, with warrant incentives tied to purchase milestones and stock price targets.
why: Multi-gigawatt commitments from two of the largest AI buyers are the clearest forward signal of accelerator demand that is already contracted rather than hoped for.

impact.mechanism: Gigawatt-scale deployment agreements lock in future accelerator purchases and pull through matching data-center power and facility build-out.

evidence.excerpt: AMD entered agreements with OpenAI and Meta for deploying up to 6 gigawatts of AMD data center GPUs each, with warrant incentives tied to purchase milestones and stock price targets
